name: pet-protocols-monorepo
description: Pet Protocols multi-tenant food ordering platform monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,USER,ADMIN,SUPERADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-user" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-admin" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-superadmin"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend-user && npm run build --prefix frontend-admin && npm run build --prefix frontend-superadmin
